stem.text: Three cells with e.m.f.s $V_{1}$, $V_{2}$ and $V_{3}$, have negligible internal resistance. These cells are connected to three resistors with resistances $R_{1}$, $R_{2}$ and $R_{3}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Single closed loop circuit with three cells and three resistors in series. The cells are labelled V1, V2 and V3 and the resistors are labelled R1, R2 and R3. An arrow labelled I on the upper wire shows the direction of the current.

stem.text: The current in the circuit is $I$.
